reason: A DeepSeek Harness file-management plugin that replaces ordinary local deletion with restorable trash operations, while supporting approved permanent purge, restore, listing, and delete-command interception.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可恢复的安全删除、回收站管理、文件恢复和经审批的永久清理功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with restorable file deletion, trash management, file recovery, and approval-gated permanent cleanup.

capabilities: Moves files and directories into a trash area instead of immediately deleting them
Lists and restores trashed entries with conflict strategies
Permanently deletes selected or all trash contents behind an approval prompt
Intercepts local bash and PowerShell delete commands and guides use of safe deletion
Provides configurable trash, retention, capacity, confirmation, and command-interception settings
